Due to an unresolved territorial dispute, no direct logistical corridor exists between Warehouse Alpha and Warehouse Beta.
Furthermore, due to a mandatory routing protocol, precisely one of the following two corridors must be incorporated into the circuit: the corridor between Warehouse Beta and Gamma, or the corridor between Warehouse Gamma and Delta.

The objective is to determine the most efficient possible inspection circuit that audits each warehouse precisely once and concludes at the origin warehouse.
